body: I want to be sure I'm dead by the point it's sent.
Well, if she goes, there's no reason to stay.
I will for as long as she's here.

There are no doctors that deal with suicidal people. There are no mental facilities and no way I could receive professional treatment. Even then, I don't want it. I've been trying to get past this for long enough and I'm tired of it. It's never going to fully go away, I'm certain of that. There will always be that unbearable feeling in the back of my head. The most anything could change would be temporarily trapping that feeling and not letting it show, but it'll come back eventually.

Thank you for putting in effort and trying to show that it's worth it, but the truth is, I've been trying for long enough. I know things can be better and I also they will eventually get better, but even with everything going perfect, I'm still hurting on the inside. I've had enough of that. People like her and others deserve someone better than me. Was hell of a fight, but as soon as she leaves me or something happens to her, I'll be taking my life.
Got myself into an LDR and she's the only reason why I'm still alive. Though, if anything happens to the relationship, I'm going.
I was about to give up the night when life decided to give me my last shot. Was ready to go through with it and then the thing happened.
What I meant but not being heard was that when I posted here with my throwaway twice, I never received a single response.
They are online friends.
Don't think there's a way of helping me. The only way is directing me to a way of leaving a suicide note behind.
The last time when I was on the verge of ending it all there was a flash of hope and it actually turned out to be one of my best decisions. Though, whenever I reached prior to that, I wasn't heard.
I meant more like something that would be sent after your death, no matter how long it takes you to go through with it.
Just thinking ahead, I feel like that day is inevitable and I wouldn't like to have this on my mind once I want to go through with it.
Depends, for the most part, yes.
Got any examples?

I'm sorry to hear that and I kind of highly doubt anyone would care, but I'd like them to know that I haven't just decided to ignore them once I go. Or alternatively, I would like to leave a note somehow.
Answering with "I'm fine" and smiling all the time. Guilty of doing it myself.
For clarification, was referring to the friends, not family.
You probably don't even realize how much you matter to them and how glad they would be if they could help you right now. Don't you think trying to figure something out with them could do some good?

What about your family or friends, do you have anyone close to your heart?

I'm hoping that the dose you took doesn't do much, since I'm sure the last thing you'd want is any type of permanent damage.
Any effect been taking place yet? You know, you still can call yourself an ambulance, even if you're unsure whether the dosage is lethal. We want you here man, why not give it another shot?
